changes.notes: Reverse the inhibition edge: AM-19226 survives exposure to the attacking V52 strain.
The four lung findings are phenotypes presented by PAO1 infection, not disease entities or generic associations.
The links from isolate names to A. veronii encode taxonomic membership, not inhabitation; retain the separately annotated tilapia-host links.
Salmonella enterica serovar Typhimurium is used here as a taxonomic target, not a specific strain identifier.
Persistence within the RAW 264.7 macrophage cell line is an inhabitation relation, not resistance to the cell line.
The first clause directly supports G9 inhibition of V. harveyi; Altermonas and Bacillus BY-9 occur in a malformed comparison to prior work and are not supported as G9 targets.
The sentence says the strains are associated with coral hosts; it does not describe infection or relations to the taxonomic synonyms Labrenzia/Roseibium.
Biofilm is a phenotype presented by the strain; the sentence does not describe biofilm as a produced compound.
